description: This file defines logging-related classes, functions, and macros for the WPEFramework project. It includes class templates for logging categories, external function declarations for dumping exceptions and system files, and macros for logging control and message handling.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class for logging categories, providing static methods to control logging behavior and access metadata.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: External function to dump exception details based on exception type.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: External function to dump system files for a given process ID.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Static method to announce the logging category.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled for the category.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables logging for the category.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the logging category.
